text_block_list.text:
"One day, with the Holy Hoof Festival drawing near.
I went to visit Air Shakur to talk about races—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Right, this just needs the finishing touches!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm almost done with this signboard too~!
What else was left to do again?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"We're free now too~!
Where should we go help out?"

"Umamusume working busily on preparations for the Holy Hoof Festival.
Looking closer, it seems there are even girls from classes other than Air Shakur's mixed in."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, wouldn't it be best to ask the commander?
I'm sure they'll give us our next instructions♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah...—the blueprints are... in her head.

Where their gazes landed as they spoke
was Air Shakur, briskly barking out
one instruction after another.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who's free, move over to the interior team.
Make sure we've got enough paint, too—wait.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer.
If you wanna talk, do it later. My hands are full right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Pretty much.
Since it's a joint project involving other grades too,
coordinating everything is a real pain.
choice_data_list: Still, you look like you're having a lot of fun.
Still, you look like you're having a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
As if this is any fun. It's a colossal pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Buuut y'know?
This year, no matter what it takes, I'm planning on taking first place in the visitor survey.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "The time has finally come, Shakur!! We're going for nothing less than first place at this year's Holy Hoof Festival! Get fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I told you, stop dragging me into this every single—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute? First place in the popularity poll...
If I use that as bait, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—So, here's an idea...
Why don't we team up for the Holy Hoof Festival?
It's not a bad deal for you guys either, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In return, once she successfully claimed 1st place—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Kukuku. You wish to forge a pact with the Lord of the Underworld...?
You appear to be utterly fearless!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what kind of gathering is this?
I want to join in on the chat too♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“—Opportunities to gather detailed data
on other classes—let alone other grades—are quite rare, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll make myself useful enough
that they'll be more than happy to provide it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, my opinion hasn't changed.
Group events are nothin' but noisy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: “Still, there's data you can only obtain by diving straight into your opponent's inner sanctum, wouldn't ya say?”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll turn a blind eye to a little noise.
I've decided to use whatever I can get my hands on, after all."

His smirking face radiated a sense of fulfillment.
Seeing how Air Shakur had grown more positive over the past few years, I felt a deep sense of reliability—
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to the day itself!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.text: And so, preparations for the Holy Hoof Festival got underway—

text_block_list.name: Female Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey!!! Hurry, hurry!!!
Ever since I saw the announcement, I made up my mind that I was absolutely going!!

text_block_list.name: Male Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's seriously insane!!
People on social media are saying the quality is monstrous—!

When I visited the concept café devised by Air Shakur,
the room was enveloped in an extraordinary level of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Food and drink are always a big hit at the Holy Hoof Festival.
Add in some solid worldbuilding, and... this much is a given.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Intoxicate yourselves to your hearts' content!!
In the presence of this fleeting, dazzling brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaa~h!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What...—would you like...—to order?

text_block_list.name: Male Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So scary!!! —Wait,
I see... the premise is that they're cyborg Umamusume.
They put an insane amount of detail into this...
Even as I look around, commotions break out across various corners of the cafe. When I tell them how splendidly everyone's unique strengths are being directed—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, call it thinking outside the box.
As long as you frame it as a 'concept',
you can get away with a sharp personality and zero friendliness.
choice_data_list: Is that why you became the "Devil"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, exactly.
So, what'll it be? What's yer order?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“If you're ready to sell your ‘soul’ to the ‘devil,’
I can get you whatever you want, you know?”

...Her smirk leaves me flustered.
And so, the concept cafe was a massive hit,
safely seizing the number one spot in popularity.

text_block_list.name: Female Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey!!! Hurry, hurry!!!
Ever since I saw the announcement, I made up my mind that I was absolutely going!!

text_block_list.name: Male Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's seriously insane!!
People on social media are saying the quality is monstrous—!

When I visited the concept café devised by Air Shakur,
the room was enveloped in an extraordinary level of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Food and drink are always a big hit at the Holy Hoof Festival.
Add in some solid worldbuilding, and... this much is a given.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Intoxicate yourselves to your hearts' content!!
In the presence of this fleeting, dazzling brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaa~h!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What...—would you like...—to order?

text_block_list.name: Male Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So scary!!! —Wait,
I see... the premise is that they're cyborg Umamusume.
They put an insane amount of detail into this...
Even as I look around, commotions break out across various corners of the cafe. But just as I'm admiring how well each person's unique strengths are being utilized—

text_block_list.name: Backstage Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Shakur-san, this is bad!!
There are way too many customers, we're out of—!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, was my estimate way too low?
Well, with business booming like this,
can't really complain, can I?

Though closing early left things feeling a bit cut short,
the concept café was a huge hit
and safely claimed the number one popularity spot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Come on, let me hear your voice!

"The day of the Holy Hoof Festival. For some reason, I ended up getting drafted to help with publicity.
I've been working nonstop since morning, but—"

text_block_list.name: Female Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"They say we can meet an Umamusume in her racewear!
Since we're here, let's go check it out!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Choosing the cafe was definitely the right call.
The advantage of meeting up close is huge, just like the annual data showed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I put the approachable folks on customer service,
and with the optimized foot traffic, guiding people will be smooth—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
By collaborating across multiple classes, we secured enough staff.
Thanks to that, wait times are down,
and the shop is running at maximum efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
With this, we're sure to rank high on the visitor survey.
Still, carelessness is our greatest enemy—
choice_data_list: I'll keep giving it my all to attract customers!
I'll keep working hard to bring in more customers!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Drink up, 'cause we're heading out.
When it comes to drawing a crowd, promo is everything.
And so, Air Shakur and the others' café took first place in popularity and broke the record for highest sales.
